body.account_rule: Exactly6+count; current local handler bound32 is not a packet/compute/wallet/public resource proof.
body.rule: Count0 valid;33/256/65535 parse as u16 but fail the current local Recover initial guard. Decode rejects count>32 as INVALID_WIRE_COUNT before6+n count comparison, not a runtime eligibility finding. Raw u16 representability is not accepted-source count.

cli.arguments: Exactly one explicit pathname; no flags/help mode/stdin/default request/output file/fetch. A --help probe is CLI_USAGE/2. A pathname beginning with - is CLI_USAGE; ./-name is an explicit pathname.
cli.file: Read-only nonblocking open, fstat opened descriptor before read, require regular file; symlink resolving to regular target allowed; close every descriptor. Read only explicitly supplied request and fixed packaged profile.
cli.json: Strict UTF8/no BOM; no duplicate keys, JSON numeric literals or nonfinite constants. Check unpaired Unicode surrogates in all decoded keys/strings before depth/string checks. Invalid scalar=>INVALID_TEXT; any decoded key/string>1024characters=>INVALID_SHAPE at $. Container root depth1, max4.
cli.output_certificate: REPORT_BOUND.json and ANALYTICAL_ENVELOPE.json; exact closed-schema independent all-input bound, not only a witness.
cli.stdout: Exactly json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+LF, UTF8. Empty stderr for fixed errors; no OS details/traceback/arbitrary input echo.

errors.message: Use exactly one local request file.
Input must be a readable regular file.
Input must be strict UTF-8 without BOM.
Input must be strict JSON without duplicate keys or numeric literals.
Input contains an invalid Unicode scalar.
Input fields or types do not match the request schema.
errors.path: nearest declared parent or typed field

errors.message: Select the explicit historical local profile.
The fixed packaged profile failed integrity validation.
Expected a canonical Base58 public key of 32 bytes.
Expected bounded lowercase even-length hexadecimal data.
Recover body must contain exactly 8 bytes.
Recover source count exceeds the local ABI bound.
Account count must equal six plus the body source count.

MISSING_PRIVILEGE.decode: descriptor.accounts[i]; one per role failing effective minima, no signer required

SOURCES_TOO_MANY.decode: unreachable: count>32 is structural error first

findings.message: Program ID differs from the fixed historical profile.
Fixed account key differs from the historical profile.
Fixed account list contains a repeated key.
Explicit source uses a fixed protected protocol key.
Explicit source list contains a repeated key.
Descriptor privilege union does not meet the role minimum.
Recover intent permits at most thirty-two explicit sources.

limits: Design512KiB; total M6D4MiB; author source/tests/evidence1.5MiB; supervisor2MiB; free2GiB. Stdlib Python3.12; zero target/native/HTTP/network/imports of old code during StageA. Future targets<=1024each role all generations, prospective serial accounting; initial<=128 recommendation, do not omit matrix obligations.

packaged_profile.read_rule: Read-only nonblocking open, fstat regular file before reads, read at most expected_size+1, close every owned descriptor; any missing/nonregular/read/size/hash failure is SOURCE_BINDING_ERROR. No caller/env/source-hash override.

privileges: OR each actual key flag over every descriptor occurrence before role minima. False required flags are not ceilings; all extra signer/writable flags permitted. No privilege outside descriptor assumed. Same OR applies even when a fixed alias is already invalid; it does not remove identity/duplicate/protection findings. Encoder emits per-role minimum occurrence flags; all is_signer=false.

protection.duplicates: Compare fixed positions0..5 with earlier fixed positions; one DUPLICATE_FIXED at each later occurrence whose key appeared earlier. Independently compare suffix source positions against earlier suffix sources; one DUPLICATE_SOURCE at each later occurrence. Never pairwise-many findings, sort/deduplicate/remove sources or conflate duplicate classes.
protection.source_rule: Explicit source key cannot equal any canonical protected key, including Custody (implicit), H/System/Reserve even though not fixed Recover metas. Runtime owner==H/sysvar or executable exclusions remain UNASSESSED.
protection.wrong_fixed_alias: A source matching an arbitrary WRONG caller-supplied fixed key is not thereby canonically protected. Report the fixed identity error; do not invent PROTECTED_SOURCE or a generic source-fixed alias finding. Existing canonical keys still trigger protection.

public_api.format_report: Unmodified report returned by the codec=>canonical UTF8 bytes. This is a serializer, not an independent validator of arbitrary caller-created report dictionaries; input/report tampering by trusted local Python code is outside JSON request handling. Output>65536 must fail visibly, never truncate.
public_api.import_time: No filesystem IO/writes, target calls or old module imports.
public_api.process_bytes: bytes request=>tuple(report,exit_code), same strict full request/profile contract, no IO except fixed-profile verification; wrong Python type raises TypeError("process_bytes requires bytes") outside JSON grammar.
public_api.process_file: Explicit pathname=>tuple(report,exit_code), bounded nonblocking regular-file input plus process_bytes contract.

report.decode_rule: Preserve exact descriptor program_id/accounts/data_hex values/raw occurrence flags/order (JSON formatting is canonical). body VALID_LOCAL_BODY; any finding=>descriptor/intent NONCONFORMANT,statusNONCONFORMANT/1; none=>allCONFORMANT/0. Full6+n account_requirements always emitted.
report.encode_rule: Collect all applicable protected/duplicate-source/too-many findings. Any finding=>NONCONFORMANT/1,body+descriptor NOT_PRODUCED, intent NONCONFORMANT,descriptor null,account_requirements[]. No finding=>canonical fixed identities/minimum flags plus unmodified source order; body VALID_LOCAL_BODY, descriptor+intent CONFORMANT/0.
report.error_rule: ERROR/2, operation null,profile UNCONFIGURED,error catalog object,validation all UNASSESSED,descriptor/intent null,account_requirements/findings empty. Input_sha256 exact fully read input bytes even for parsing/profile errors, null for usage/unreadable/oversized. profile_sha256/source_bindings are fixed embodied-version references even on errors, not successful trust attestations.
report.finding_order: ASCII ascending(path,code), at most one per pair; fixed catalog source_ids/message, no dynamic/echo text. Fixed/source duplicates are per-later-occurrence, not every pair.
report.normal_rule: Normal operation/profile exact request/selected local; error null,input hash exact. Intent sources preserve order and count is decimal string; decoder sources actual metas6.., count equals body. No receipt/amount/R/price/reward quantity is computed or claimed; fixed receipt_verified=false and UNASSESSED assessments remain. All keys always present.
report.path_rules: Whole parser/CLI/depth/globalstring errors at $. Unknown/missing child or bad object/list at its nearest declared container. Missing schema/mismatch=>schema; bad/missing operation=>operation. Missing branch payload=>$; profile errors=>profile; key errors exact key field; flags descriptor.accounts[i].is_signer/.is_writable. Encoder sources element path intent.sources[j].
report.source_bindings_meaning: Exact PROFILE.sources path=>SHA map, not runtime rereads of current source/public state.

common.profile: optional only for fail-closed behavior: absent/null/UNCONFIGURED=>PROFILE_UNCONFIGURED. Exact LOCAL_M3_HISTORICAL_V1 enabled; other string=>UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE; other type=>INVALID_SHAPE at profile.

decode.accounts: Explicit ordered0..39 exact meta objects; flags actual bool. Length>39=>INVALID_SHAPE at descriptor.accounts. Later body-count check permits only6..38 normal reports.
decode.data_hex: ASCII lowercase [0-9a-f]*, even length, at most512characters; then exact8byte body. No Base64/encoding alternative.

encode.sources: Explicit required ordered list of canonical public keys. Shape admits0..33 items: length33 is SOURCES_TOO_MANY invalid intent, descriptor not produced. More than33 is INVALID_SHAPE at intent.sources. No count_override/source_count/amount/recipient/signers/route/discovery defaults.

stage: A design only; no client code or target invocation assigned

suffix_role.rendering: source[0],source[1] etc.; numeric index is decimal string

typed_fields.counts: No JSON count input exists. Body count is u16LE; encode derives it from the explicitly supplied list, never an override. Every report count/index is a canonical decimal string; bool/null retain type.
typed_fields.pubkey: Canonical Base58 exactly32 decoded bytes,32..44characters, exact re-encoding; no curve/signability/owner/holder eligibility check. Alphabet123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz.

validation_order: Strict JSON numeric/duplicate rejection; all Unicode scalars; then max container depth4 and decoded string/key length1024
Root object and unknown keys from union; schema; operation; exact required branch root keys except optional profile; profile type/select
Fixed packaged PROFILE regular-file/size/SHA check against compiled pin
Encode intent exact shape; sources array shape/length<=33; then each public key in list order
Decode descriptor exact shape; program_id public key; accounts array shape/size<=39; each exact meta then pubkey,is_signer,is_writable in index order; data_hex grammar
Decode body exact8length, exact header, count<=32, actual6+count metas
Collect every applicable static finding; sort; encode invalid intent emits no descriptor; decode preserves complete structurally valid descriptor with findings
